google_review_notes: No login required. All features of Mahjong Solitaire are reachable from the main menu: Play (500 tile-matching levels, each deal verified clearable), Daily puzzle (one board per day), Levels (level list plus Endless random boards), Shop, Settings (sound, vibration, high-contrast tiles, dim held tiles). Offline tile game with AdMob ads and optional in-app purchases. Lives are only used by Endless boards; campaign levels and the Daily never cost a life.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test IAPs, open the Shop from Mahjong Solitaire's main menu. No demo account needed.
